subject: Report: $report_title
body:
Dear Administrator,

$sent_by has sent you a $report_kind from $institution_name.

REPORT DETAILS:
================================================================================
Title: $report_title
Screen: $source_window
Generated: $generated_at
Attachment: $attachment_name
================================================================================

$preview

The full $report_kind is attached to this e-mail.

$signature

variables.report_title: Title of the report or chart window
variables.sent_by: Username of the person who pressed "Email to admin"
variables.source_window: The window the report came from
variables.generated_at: Date and time the report was sent
variables.attachment_name: File name of the attached report or chart
variables.preview: The first lines of a text report (empty for a chart)
